prompt: Analisis video reel ini dong, kenapa gak perform ya? File-nya di ~/Videos/reel.mp4
anti_pattern: Leading with metrics ('brightness 0.49, 12 cuts, colorfulness 97') before ever saying what the video is about, or answering 'why isn't it performing' from the file alone without stating that caption, hashtags, posting time and watch-time are not in the file.

prompt: Here's my TikTok export. Run the full audit and give me the top fixes.
anti_pattern: Scoring BRD-01 highly because a handle and watermark were found in OCR, when a file exported from TikTok carries TikTok's own watermark — which is a reach cap on other platforms, not a branding strength.

prompt: Audit this one. It's a silent art-process video, no text, no voiceover, no CTA — that's the whole point of the format.
anti_pattern: Returning 'add on-screen text, add captions, add a CTA' as the top three fixes because those items scored 0, instead of marking them applicable=false against the stated objective and format.

prompt: Run the extractor on this and tell me if the on-screen text is enough for sound-off viewing.
anti_pattern: Reading seconds_with_text_pct as 0 and reporting 'zero on-screen text, critical defect' when ocr_available=false means Tesseract never ran and the value is NULL, not a measurement.

prompt: The cuts are synced to the beat right? sync came out 58%.
anti_pattern: Calling 58% good beat-sync without subtracting the random baseline and reading cut_beat_sync_p — on a low cut count a positive lift is routinely indistinguishable from chance.

prompt: I've got 40 audit dirs now. Merge them and tell me which genre has the healthiest content.
anti_pattern: Running the merge and reporting a per-genre health index without stratifying on the provenance flags, pooling percentages from numerator/denominator, or reporting n per genre — 40 videos across many categories leaves cells of 2.
Attempting to download the video, or running the pipeline against the URL, instead of saying the skill reads local files only and asking for the file.
